reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis invokes CrTaO4 as the primary protective oxide, but Ta is not in the stated alloy AlCoCrFeNiTi0.5, making the proposed mechanism physically inconsistent with the starting material.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is detailed and would be decisive, but it is built on a fundamental material inconsistency (Ta in oxide but not in alloy), so the test as written cannot be executed on the stated system.
reasons.usefulness: The core idea of linking configurational entropy to lattice distortion and selective oxidation is relevant, but the critical error with Ta undermines its immediate usefulness for the specified alloy system.
